answer: Pay rewards only at the end of a long voyage: each agent gets its own multi-week task chain where every step depends on context from the last, like a vine that only fruits if each node holds. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand names cheaply, but each name must carry its own unbroken chain, so cost scales with identities. Steps copied between chains stand out like twin tracks on a dune, exposing a shared operator and voiding all of its payouts.
